# The bare stdlib keyword is the merged view: everything a file sees without
# naming a package. `button` comes from sngl://std, `color` from sngl://builtin.
sngl doc sngl
stdout '# sngl'
stdout 'button'
stdout 'color'

# Each tier is addressable on its own, and the two are disjoint.
sngl doc sngl://std
stdout 'button'
! stdout '\*\*color\*\*'

sngl doc sngl://builtin
stdout 'color'
! stdout '\*\*button\*\*'

# The package set follows the lib/ directories, so an unknown one is named.
! sngl doc sngl://nope
stderr 'unknown stdlib package "nope"'

# Stdlib decl lookup.
sngl doc sngl button
stdout '# button'

# An alias declared in the CWD's package resolves to the imported directory.
sngl doc w
stdout 'Counter'

# Local directory still indexes as before.
sngl doc ./widgets
stdout 'Counter'

# Unknown scheme surfaces an error (nonzero exit).
! sngl doc bogus://nope

-- app.sngl --
import w "./widgets"
component main {
    w.Counter(count = 1)
}
-- widgets/widgets.sngl --
component Counter(count int) {
    text { value = "count: ${count}" }
}
